model.name: Folder
model.description: R40.86 (Tron overrule): the domain Folder class IMPLEMENTS DropTarget ONCE — every folder everywhere (room / model-collection / diagrams / nested / not-yet-existing) IS a drop target by virtue of being a Folder. No per-surface gate; supersedes the per-container DropDispatcher.acceptDropIntoContainer (a81ed3db) carve-out model.
